issue: Connecticut explicitly denies spendthrift protection to self-settled trusts. This creates a fundamental conflict with states like Delaware and Alaska that provide strong self-settled asset protection for DAPT-qualified transfers. A trust governed by Connecticut law may not receive DAPT protection even if the trustee structure is designed for DAPT compliance.
date_relationship: CT CUTS effective 2008-07-01. DE DAPT effective 2015-07-01.
factual_distinctions: CT CUTS explicitly prohibits self-settled spendthrift protection.
DE DAPT explicitly authorizes self-settled asset protection subject to conditions.
unresolved_questions: Whether a CT-governed trust with a DE DAPT trustee structure is effective for asset protection purposes.
Whether DE law applies to a CT-governed trust that migrates situs to DE.
